cells.quote: Though the district intends to expand access to WBL, the vast majority of WBL participants have so far been CTE students whose participation was embedded into their CTE programming.
cells.note: The study reports a distribution of WBL participants, not a causal effect or printed effect size.

O.outcome_detail: weekly aggregated number of completed workplace-based assessments

cells.quote: "In nearly all blocks across all years there are more assessments completed in secondary care, especially when secondary care is the first placement block, and early in the placement more generally."
cells.note: The quoted finding is from the wiki entry because the supplied study text does not include the results sentence reporting the direction. The study text describes Year 1 students, clinical skills WBA, and placement blocks lasting 8–10 weeks.
